network_cidr.description: Local network (CIDR notation) allowed to query NTP from this server.

upstream_servers.description: Public NTP servers to use as time sources. At least 2–3 are recommended.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of upstream NTP server.

primary_upstream.description: Hostname of the preferred upstream server (enables faster initial synchronization). Leave blank to disable makestep tuning.

log_dir.description: Directory where Chrony will store logs, measurements, and statistics.

enable_broadcast.description: Enable broadcast mode so clients can listen for NTP broadcasts (rarely needed in modern setups).

dnsmasq_ntp_interfaces.description: Interfaces (IPs) where Chrony will bind for NTP responses, typically including localhost and LAN gateway.

items.description: IP address (e.g., 127.0.0.1 or 192.168.1.1) to bind NTP service on.

restricted_hosts.description: List of hostnames or CIDRs to deny NTP access (optional).

items.description: Host or subnet to deny (e.g., 10.0.0.0/8 or host.example.com).

allowed_hosts.description: Additional hosts or subnets explicitly allowed (optional, e.g., for meshed LAN time distribution).

driftfile_path.description: Custom path to the drift file (where Chrony stores clock rate correction). Leave blank for system default.

keyfile_path.description: Custom path to the key file (for NTP authentication). Leave blank if authentication is not used.
